description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the number of datasets collected over time, categorized by whether they originate from a single data source or multiple sources. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Year," and displays discrete years in chronological order from 2012 to 2022. The vertical value axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to just above 110, with numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 20. The chart features bars grouped by year, corresponding to a legend titled "Data sources," which defines "1" data source as blue bars and "2+" data sources as orange bars positioned side-by-side within each yearly group. The blue bars representing 1 data source range from a minimum of approximately 1 in 2015 (with no bar visible in 2012) to the tallest bar overall on the chart at approximately 113 in 2021. The orange bars representing 2+ data sources are not visible in 2013 and 2014, and reach their maximum height of approximately 47 in 2021. The bars are sorted chronologically from left to right, and the bars for the final year, 2022, are visually distinguished from the rest of the chart by being rendered in lighter, faded shades of blue and orange.
